searchText: Please can I get a review/approval for merging https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8074 Also, <@642887713246150666>, you've had some ideas (eg. here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/931#issuecomment-1877120667) regarding how RIPs fit into the greater standards ecosystem, and generally it's a topic that <@415548822983278593> and I would love to discuss further. Would us joining the next EIPIP call be a good platform for this? It will be great to have people on the EIPIP meeting planned on Jan 17th at 17:30 UTC The item is already added to the agenda: https://github.com/ethcatherders/EIPIP/issues/305
